title: 麦格理Ellie Jiang：中国互联网估值重估至8-9倍，底部在哪里？
speaker: Ellie Jiang

segments.en: How should I be looking at, I mean, you talked about, right, you know, maybe it is the hyperscalers that, you know, fundamentals, I mean, maybe a little bit more sound versus like, I mean, how do you look at the hardware space?
segments.zh: 我该怎么看呢？你提到过，也许超大规模厂商的基本面稍好一些，那你怎么看硬件领域？

segments.en: Because we have seen quite a bit of evaluation reset on some of these stocks, but they're still looking quite expensive compared to, you know, some of the big internet platforms too.
segments.zh: 因为我们已经看到这些权益资产经历了相当大的估值重估，但相比一些大型互联网平台，它们看起来仍然相当昂贵。

segments.en: I think ultimately when it comes to China AI stack, it's all about quality selection. Ultimately, this is a space that is still in their early stage of the development.
segments.zh: 我认为最终在中国AI技术栈方面，关键在于精选优质标的。归根结底，这个领域仍处于发展的早期阶段。

segments.en: So you could argue that when we look at the Chinese hyperscalers running their CapEx 2 years behind the US, the domestic stack is probably even later than that, right?
segments.zh: 所以可以说，当我们看中国超大规模厂商的资本开支比美国落后两年时，国内技术栈可能还要更晚，对吧？

segments.en: And this is also being blessed by a lot of the governments from entities in terms of capital injection, in terms of the local support.
segments.zh: 这也得到了许多政府实体的支持，包括资本注入和地方支持。

segments.en: So eventually from investors perspective, when you're looking at this internal landscape, of course, it's pretty constructive that we are seeing domestic stack gradually catches up and taking a larger portion within the total AI stack contribution.
segments.zh: 所以最终从市场参与者角度看，观察这个内部格局时，看到国内技术栈逐渐赶上并在整体AI技术栈贡献中占据更大份额，当然是有建设性的。

segments.en: But when we are sort of going through in the next two to three years, the quality names would matter the most.
segments.zh: 但在未来两到三年里，优质标的将最为重要。

segments.en: So again, coming back to the idea of, you know, you should be really focusing more on this free cash flow of visibility and whether the companies have enough capability to really sell fund, right?
segments.zh: 所以再次回到这个观点：你应该更关注自由现金流的可见性，以及公司是否有足够能力真正实现自筹资金，对吧？

segments.en: If things don't really go well. What could put a floor on this right now?
segments.zh: 如果情况不太顺利，现在什么能提供底部支撑？

segments.en: That's always the hardest question.
segments.zh: 这总是最难的问题。

segments.en: What is the floor for Chinese internet names, especially given that they have been trading at such a distressed multiple?
segments.zh: 中国互联网公司的底部在哪里，尤其是考虑到它们一直以如此低迷的估值倍数交易？

segments.en: When we look at our sector, the entire sector multiple is basically retrieving back to around 2023, 12-level.
segments.zh: 当我们看这个板块时，整个板块的估值倍数基本上回到2023年左右的12倍水平。

segments.en: So we're talking about a blended average of around 8 to 9 times forward P.
segments.zh: 所以我们说的是大约8到9倍远期市盈率的混合平均值。

segments.en: So it's quite cheap, even if you put it in the global context.
segments.zh: 所以即使放在全球背景下，这也相当便宜。

segments.en: Now, what's happening going forward is one, I think shareholder return is something that people care.
segments.zh: 接下来会发生什么，第一，我认为股东回报是人们关心的事情。

segments.en: Especially in the times of uncertainty, people actually appreciate more in terms of that guaranteed return.
segments.zh: 尤其是在不确定时期，人们实际上更欣赏那种有保证的回报。

segments.en: Two is whether these companies can really find a support level for the earnings.
segments.zh: 第二，这些公司能否真正找到盈利的支撑位。

segments.en: And in fact, with all of these ongoing changes from BIS, from the external side, we are seeing, for example, Tencent potentially seeing the trough of that earnings downward revision.
segments.zh: 事实上，随着BIS和外部方面所有这些持续变化，我们看到，例如腾讯可能看到盈利下调的谷底。

segments.en: So in 2027, we might see into second half their free cash flow could turn back to positive.
segments.zh: 所以在2027年，我们可能会看到下半年他们的自由现金流可能转回正值。

segments.en: That could also serve as a key catalyst to drive this stock as well.
segments.zh: 这也可能成为推动这只权益资产的关键催化剂。

segments.en: Okay, beyond just the internet platforms, what else are you tracking in terms of the earnings side of things?
segments.zh: 好的，除了互联网平台，在盈利方面你还关注哪些？
